title: 1.9x per watt: OpenAI just benchmarked Nvidia with its own chip
description:
1.9x per watt: OpenAI just benchmarked Nvidia with its own chip

At Hot Chips 2026, OpenAI presented Jalapeño, the inference chip it built with Broadcom, and put Nvidia's rack systems on the same slide.

The claim: 1.5x to 1.9x more throughput per kilowatt than Nvidia's GB200 and GB300, and 1.7x to 3.6x lower end-to-end latency. The package draws 700W. The GB300 it was measured against is rated at 1,400W.

Two caveats that belong next to those numbers.

The benchmark was written by the buyer. OpenAI is one of Nvidia's largest customers, and it is now publishing figures where its own silicon wins.

And the memory is not matched. Jalapeño carries 216 GB of HBM4 at 15.4 TB/s. The GB300 carries 288 GB of the older HBM3e. Part of that efficiency gap is a memory generation, not an architecture.

None of this makes the result fake. It makes it interested. The honest answer is that nobody outside those two companies knows who wins until Nvidia's Rubin generation ships and someone neutral runs both.
